batch: Variedad de Arquitectura -- 5 looks nuevos por manifiesto tipado

96.titulo: Sapphire Mirror Dress en el Penthouse
96.concepto: Penthouse/Off-duty, el mayor deficit real del roster (ultimo look del arquetipo: L51, hace 45 looks). Arquitectura M6 (vestido de segunda piel, CUBIERTA) -- bloqueadas M1, M9, M3 por la ventana global de 3, y libre contra el lote anterior (L91-95 uso M5/M8/M1/M9/M3, ninguno M6). Zafiro: familia azul, el eco de su iris cobalto (perfil §5.2b), ausente en toda la ventana de color de los ultimos 4 looks. El rosa firma va en el ribete del dobladillo, discreto pero presente en toda la prenda.

prendas.descripcion: , a high halter neckline plunging to the sternum and fastened behind the neck by a small chrome ring, the back left bare to the base of the spine, a thigh-high slit cut into the left side seam, a hot-pink neon piping tracing the entire hemline
a fine chrome choker with no lettering and a matching chrome cuff on one wrist; small sapphire drop earrings
no hosiery tonight, legs bare and glossy; hands ungloved
eyeshadow in sapphire-blue shimmer coordinated with the dress, lips in glossy deep wine
almond-shaped nails at 5cm, a sapphire-blue chrome finish
closed pointed-toe platform stiletto pumps in midnight-blue patent vinyl, 8-inch platform, chrome mirror finish on the platform edge, hot-pink undersole, a razor-thin metal needle heel

96.setting: her own penthouse at night, floor-to-ceiling glass and the city skyline below, low cold blue lighting

97.concepto: Bikini/Lenceria Erotica (ultimo look del arquetipo: L83, hace 13 looks). Arquitectura M2 (micro bikini, piel) -- libre en la ventana de 3 (L94-96 fueron M9/M3/M6) y libre contra el lote anterior. Jade: familia verde, ausente en toda la casa desde el L84 (esmeralda). Frontera con VIP (§6): la prenda ES el sujeto de la toma, el escenario de piscina existe para lucirla. Rosa firma en la cinta de la cadera.

prendas.descripcion: , the top's triangle cups strung on a fine chrome ring at the sternum, the bottom a high-leg g-string riding high on the hip bones, a hot-pink neon ribbon knotted at the left hip
a slim chrome anklet on the right leg; small chrome hoop earrings, nothing at the throat
no hosiery, legs bare and glossy; hands ungloved
eyeshadow in emerald-teal smoky, lips in glossy oxblood
coffin-shaped nails at 5cm, a jade-green chrome finish

closed pointed-toe platform stiletto sandals in jade patent vinyl, 8-inch platform, chrome mirror finish, hot-pink undersole, a razor-thin metal needle heel, a single ankle strap with a chrome pin buckle

97.setting: a private rooftop cabana beside an infinity pool at dusk, chrome loungers and cold blue pool light

98.concepto: Club/Escenario, su arquetipo de mayor peso (18%), ultimo uso L89, hace 9 looks. Arquitectura M7 (minifalda + top, CUBIERTA) -- unico codigo libre a la vez contra la ventana de 3 (L95-97: M3/M6/M2) y contra el lote anterior completo (L91-95 uso M5/M8/M1/M9/M3): M7 es el unico de los diez que ninguno de los dos bloqueos toca. Violeta electrico: familia violeta, ausente en la ventana de color de los ultimos 4 looks. Rosa firma en la cadena que cruza la cadera.

prendas.descripcion: , the miniskirt riding low on the hips with a single chrome ring at one hip, the crop top cut halter-style with a plunging V to the sternum and closed by a small chrome hook, a hot-pink neon chain looping from the skirt's hip ring across to the top's hem
a slim chrome collar with no lettering, chrome cuffs on both wrists
sheer black fishnet stockings, the waistband hidden beneath the miniskirt
eyeshadow in UV-violet smoky, lips in glossy blood-red
stiletto-shaped nails at 5cm, a violet chrome finish
closed pointed-toe platform stiletto pumps in violet patent vinyl, 8-inch platform, chrome mirror finish, hot-pink undersole, a razor-thin metal needle heel

98.setting: a revue stage seen from the wings, heavy violet-lit smoke drifting over black lacquer, cold chrome footlights along its edge

99.titulo: Champagne Robe sobre Guepiere en el Loft
99.concepto: VIP/Privado, ultimo uso L91, hace 8 looks. Arquitectura M4 (guepiere + tanga, piel) -- libre en la ventana de 3 (L96-98: M6/M2/M7) y libre contra el lote anterior (que uso M4 como codigo pero via A6 overbust en el L85, fuera de este lote; el lote INMEDIATO anterior real, L91-95, uso M5/M8/M1/M9/M3, sin M4). Champagne: familia metal, ausente en la ventana de color de los ultimos 4 looks; hardware en oro viejo, nunca cromo, siguiendo la recomendacion tecnica vigente de la Ama sobre calidos (perfil §5.2b/§5.2c). PAGA LA CUOTA DE BATA del §5.1b -- gasa semitransparente, largo al suelo, punos acampanados anchos, nunca saten opaco ni bata corta -- que era el piso pendiente de la pareja VIP/Penthouse de este lote (L96 Penthouse no llevo bata). Es una ESCENA (frontera §6): la energia de sala privada manda, la lenceria es contexto.

prendas.descripcion: , left open and draped off both shoulders with dramatic wide bell-shaped cuffs, cinched loosely at the waist with a thin champagne sash tied in a hot-pink neon knot, the fabric sheer enough to read the guepiere beneath it from every angle including from behind
cinching the waist alone with its antique-gold boning left the bust uncovered above it, laced up the back and finished as a thong at the back, its front a slim tapered panel
a fine antique-gold chain at the throat, small antique-gold hoop earrings
no hosiery, legs bare beneath the robe; hands ungloved
eyeshadow in deep plum smoky, lips in glossy deep berry
square-shaped nails at 5cm, a champagne-gold gloss finish
closed pointed-toe platform stiletto pumps in champagne patent vinyl, 8-inch platform, antique-gold mirror finish, hot-pink undersole, a razor-thin metal needle heel

99.setting: a private loft lounge after hours, floor cushions and low amber lighting

100.titulo: Onyx Slip Dress en el Estudio
100.concepto: Editorial/Portada, ultimo uso L93, hace 6 looks. Arquitectura M10 (slip dress de malla sobre lenceria, CUBIERTA) -- libre en la ventana de 3 (L97-99: M2/M7/M4) y libre contra el lote anterior (L91-95 sin M10). Onix: familia neutral-oscura, ausente en la ventana de color de los ultimos 4 looks. Cierra el lote con la segunda silueta cubierta (junto al L96), pasando comodo la cuota de 1 de cada 4. Rosa firma en el cordon que cierra el escote.

prendas.descripcion: worn over a matching lingerie set beneath, its sheer mesh reading the bralette and g-string clearly through the fabric from every angle, thin straps crossing the bare back, a hot-pink neon cord lacing the plunging neckline closed
a fine chrome chain at the throat, small chrome studs at the ears
sheer black stockings, 15 denier, seamed up the back of each leg
eyeshadow in cobalt-blue shimmer, lips in glossy crimson-plum
almond-shaped nails at 5cm, an onyx-black chrome gloss
closed pointed-toe platform stiletto pumps in black patent vinyl, 8-inch platform, chrome mirror finish, hot-pink undersole, a razor-thin metal needle heel

100.setting: a stark white cyclorama studio under hard editorial lighting
